name: Resource Dialog Form
description: Defines the reviewed Workbench modal structure for a compact resource form with keyboard-aware actions.

states: Open Manage Project from a Project menu and inspect the title, description, field rhythm, and footer actions.
Open Manage Workspace from a Workspace menu and compare the shared dialog organization and shortcuts.

useWhen: A compact Workbench resource has passed repository modal admission and needs a titled form with confirm or cancel actions.
The form must share the established dialog body, footer, cancellation, validation, and submission structure.
avoidWhen: The workflow needs a full-page editor, multistep navigation, or a persistent inspector surface.
A destructive decision only needs the shared anchored or modal confirmation pattern without editable fields.
invariants: The title and any decision-relevant description explain the resource and outcome before the first editable field.
Every editable field has a visible label; placeholders are optional, and contextual descriptions appear only when validation or platform limits matter.
Cancel and submit preserve native form semantics; when Escape cancels and Enter submits unambiguously, their buttons expose aria-hidden Kbd hints for discovery.
